tag along: My little brother always wants to tag along when I go to the movies with my classmates.
每次我和同學去看電影，我弟弟總是想跟著去。
tag someone in a photo: Please ask before you tag someone in a photo on social media, because not everyone likes being shown online.
在社群媒體的照片中標記某人之前請先詢問，因為不是每個人都喜歡被公開在網路上。
a price tag: The jacket looked cheap, but when I checked a price tag hanging from the sleeve, it said three thousand dollars.
那件夾克看起來很便宜，但我查看掛在袖子上的價格標籤時，上面寫著三千元。
tag a bag: Before checking in at the airport, you should tag a bag with your name and phone number in case it gets lost.
在機場報到前，你應該為行李掛上寫有姓名和電話的行李牌，以防遺失。
tailor the course to: Our English teacher tried to tailor the course to students who wanted to prepare for the college entrance exam.
我們的英文老師試著為想準備大學入學考試的學生量身訂做課程。
tailored to individual needs: The gym offers exercise plans tailored to individual needs, so beginners and athletes can both train safely.
這家健身房提供依個別需求訂製的運動計畫，讓初學者和運動員都能安全地訓練。
tailor a suit: Before his wedding, my cousin visited a shop in Taipei to tailor a suit that would fit him perfectly.
婚禮前，我表哥到台北一家店訂做一套完全合身的西裝。
tailor-made: The travel agency planned a tailor-made trip for my grandparents, with slow walks and plenty of rest stops.
旅行社為我祖父母規劃了一趟量身打造的旅程，行程步調緩慢且有很多休息點。
take responsibility: When the class project failed, our team leader was willing to take responsibility instead of blaming others.
班級專題失敗時，我們的組長願意負起責任，而不是怪罪別人。
take advantage of: Students should take advantage of the free library programs during summer vacation to improve their reading skills.
學生應該利用暑假期間免費的圖書館活動來提升閱讀能力。
take place: The school sports day will take place next Friday, so all classes must practice their relay races this week.
學校運動會將在下週五舉行，所以各班這週都必須練習大隊接力。
take effect: The new law banning plastic straws will take effect next month, so many shops are buying paper ones.
禁用塑膠吸管的新法規將於下個月生效，因此許多店家正在購買紙吸管。
take a risk: Starting her own bakery was a big decision, but Lisa was ready to take a risk and follow her dream.
自己開麵包店是個重大決定，但麗莎已經準備好冒險，追求她的夢想。
take one's time: There's no need to hurry with the test; just take your time and check every answer carefully.
這個考試不用急；慢慢來，仔細檢查每一個答案。
take into account: When choosing a university, you should take into account the cost of living as well as the school's ranking.
選擇大學時，你應該考慮生活開銷以及學校的排名。
take a stand: Many young people decided to take a stand against plastic waste by bringing their own cups and bags.
許多年輕人決定表明反對塑膠垃圾的立場，自備杯子和袋子。
take office: The new mayor will take office in December and has promised to build more parks for families.
新市長將於十二月就職，並承諾為家庭興建更多公園。
take a toll: Staying up late every night to study can take a toll on your health and make you feel tired in class.
每天熬夜讀書會對你的健康造成損害，讓你上課時感到疲倦。
tame inflation: The central bank raised interest rates again this year in order to tame inflation and keep prices steady.
中央銀行今年再次升息，以抑制通膨並維持物價穩定。
tame a wild horse: It took the farmer several months of patient training to tame a wild horse that no one could ride.
那位農夫花了好幾個月耐心訓練，才馴服一匹沒人騎得了的野馬。
tame one's temper: Coach Lin told the player that he must learn to tame his temper or he would be sent off again.
林教練告訴那名球員，他必須學會控制自己的脾氣，否則又會被罰下場。
tame the wilderness: Early settlers worked for years to tame the wilderness, cutting down forests to build farms and villages.
早期的移民辛苦了許多年開墾荒野，砍伐森林來建立農場和村莊。
a tame response: The comedian expected loud laughter, but his joke only got a tame response from the quiet audience.
那位喜劇演員原本期待哄堂大笑，但他的笑話只得到安靜觀眾平淡的反應。
get tangled up in: I don't want to get tangled up in their argument, so I left the room before they started shouting.
我不想捲入他們的爭吵，所以在他們開始大吼之前就離開了房間。
tangle with the law: His parents warned him that anyone who drives after drinking will sooner or later tangle with the law.
他的父母警告他，任何酒後開車的人遲早都會惹上法律問題。
tangle with someone: Everyone in our class knows it is a bad idea to tangle with someone as stubborn as Kevin.
我們班上每個人都知道，跟像凱文這麼固執的人起衝突不是好主意。
a tangled web: The detective slowly uncovered a tangled web of lies, secret meetings, and stolen money behind the crime.
偵探慢慢揭開了這起犯罪背後由謊言、秘密會面和贓款交織而成的錯綜複雜的局面。
tangled hair: After riding her bike on the windy beach, Mia spent ten minutes brushing her tangled hair in the mirror.
在風很大的海邊騎完腳踏車後，米亞花了十分鐘對著鏡子梳理她打結的頭髮。
